THE PRODUCT

AI compares supplier security documents with your questions and cites the answers.

For procurement and information-security teams. Proofline reads policies, questionnaires and supporting reports, then drafts a review showing what is supported, unclear or still missing.

THE PRODUCT, IN USE

A security answer
should come with a source.

Choose a case, run the prepared analysis and open the evidence behind each finding. The decision stays with the person responsible for the work.

WHAT THE TEAM RECEIVES

A report you can
actually review.

The drafted response explains the scope gap and cites both documents. The reviewer decides whether the answer is sufficient.

01

The source

Open the relevant extract and see which file or observation supports the finding.

02

A specific finding

Read what changed, what conflicts or what evidence is still missing.

03

An operator action

A risk reviewer accepts the answer or requests more evidence.

04

A retained decision

Accept the prepared finding for review, add a note in the register and download the report.

HOW THE JOB GETS DONE

Four steps.
One useful decision.

A drafted answer is not an assurance opinion or certification. A qualified reviewer decides whether the evidence is sufficient.

  1. 01

    Read the evidence pack

    Read the vendor’s supplied policies, questionnaire and supporting reports.

  2. 02

    Match each question

    Find the relevant passage and preserve the document reference.

  3. 03

    Identify the gaps

    Show contradictory answers, unclear scope and missing supporting evidence.

  4. 04

    Review before sending

    A risk reviewer accepts the answer or requests more evidence.
